comment: Reset to shipped on a docker's Elements… page undoes that docker's edits only. On the Colour Picker's page the scenario shows Hex Input, hides Picker Shape and moves Swatches first, then on the Layers page hides Opacity. Back on the Colour Picker's page Reset to shipped is pressed through layout_gesture, and layout_rows reads the Colour Picker's order and switches as a fresh profile has them, the first layout_rows of the run, while the Layers page still has Opacity off. The shots show the button at the foot of the list, before and after.
